description: This operation retrieves the route set information for an Express Route Gateway based on their resiliency

operations.description: This operation retrieves the route set information for an Express Route Gateway based on their resiliency

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The name of the virtual network gateway.
params.name: virtualNetworkGatewayName

params.description: Attempt to recalculate the Route Sets Information for the gateway
params.name: attemptRefresh

props.description: Link to the Express Route circuit
props.name: link

props.description: Peering location of the Express Route Circuit
props.name: location

props.description: Dictionary containing map of the circuit id and circuit details
props.name: circuitsMetadataMap

props.description: Timestamp denoting the last time when the route sets were computed for the gateway
props.name: lastComputedTime

props.description: Timestamp denoting the next eligible time to re-compute the route sets for the gateway
props.name: nextEligibleComputeTime

props.description: Flag to indicate if the route learned from the primary device is active or passive
props.name: pri

props.description: Flag to indicate if the route learned from the secondary device is active or passive
props.name: sec

props.description: List of different locations from where the routes are learned
props.name: locations
